aws:cdk:cloudformation:props.description: Common dependencies and utilities for BudgetBuddy Lambda functions to reduce cold start times
BudgetBuddy authentication handler for user registration, login, and profile management
BudgetBuddy budget handler for CRUD operations, categories, and zero-based calculations
BudgetBuddy transaction handler for expense/income tracking and automatic budget updates
BudgetBuddy AI handler for personalized budget generation using AWS Bedrock Claude 3.5
BudgetBuddy family handler for shared accounts, invitations, and member management
BudgetBuddy payment handler for Stripe integration and subscription management
BudgetBuddy email handler for notifications, tips delivery, and family invitations via SES
BudgetBuddy admin handler for dashboard operations, user management, and analytics
BudgetBuddy REST API for web and mobile clients with serverless Lambda backend
